facts.claim: MSC Fantasia (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2008; 137,936 GT; 3274 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 348 m length; Fantasia class.
MSC Fantasia is a Fantasia-class cruise ship owned and operated by MSC Cruises and serves as the lead vessel for the Fantasia class of ships.

catalogSpecs.description: Fantasia-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2008; 137,936 GT; approx. 3,274 guests at double occupancy.
